notes.title: Customizable Controls Update: Sprint, Dash, and Jump Keys Now Rebindable
notes.notes: I'm excited to announce a major update to the settings menu! You can now fully customize your keybindings for sprinting, dashing, and jumping, giving you the freedom to adjust controls based on your playstyle. These settings will be saved across all sessions, so once you configure them, your setup is ready every time you start the game. Whether you’re looking to optimize your mobility or personalize your controls, this update is designed to improve your overall experience.

notes.title: Loot Collection and Settings Update: Smoother Gameplay and Persistent Preference
notes.notes:
In this latest update, I’ve significantly improved the loot chest and experience orb pickup radius to ensure they no longer get stuck behind unreachable obstacles. This refinement guarantees a smoother and more rewarding collection experience.

I’ve also enhanced the game's settings functionality. Your settings, including volume controls, will now save persistently, even after closing the game. No need to readjust your preferences each time you play—your customized settings will now be automatically stored and ready for your next session.

Enjoy a more seamless gameplay experience with these crucial improvements!

notes.title: Weapon Drop Rates Update
notes.notes:
Prepare yourself for an exciting journey of discovery with the latest update on weapon drop rates:

Common Weapons: 0.02% chance (1 in 5,000)
Uncommon Weapons: 0.01% chance (1 in 10,000)
Rare Weapons: 0.005% chance (1 in 20,000)
Epic Weapons: 0.002% chance (1 in 50,000)
Legendary Weapons: 0.001% chance (1 in 100,000)
Godlike Weapons: 0.0001% chance (1 in 1,000,000)
